_note: Candidate registry for West Virginia 2026. Every record comes from the state's official list of candidates for the November 3, 2026 general election (West Virginia Secretary of State, Candidates Listing by Office, election "11/03/2026 - GENERAL 2026", Regular Candidates (the "2026 Candidates Listing" linked from the SOS candidate search page; retrieved 2026-10-16), linked in source_url; a race from another official list links it in roster_source_url). Names and party labels are as the list prints them (mixed case where the list prints capitals). Nothing in a record is invented: no bios, photos, websites or fundraising.
